reference_measurements.settings: mini-swe-agent per Scale asterisk; separate public benchmark evaluation.
Claude Code. Organizer reports 63.8 under Terminus 2 for the same checkpoint.
Anthropic system card; 25 trials, adaptive thinking and max effort. Distinct benchmark from SWE-bench Pro.

discovery_notes.observation: The official Qwen Hub search returned no Qwen4-named downloadable checkpoint. Hosted API availability is separate.
Official Google Hub searches for Gemma 4.1 and Gemma 5 returned no matching released weight IDs in this audit.
The published Mistral Large 4 checkpoint exceeds the total-size rule. Medium 3.5 has been deprecated; Small 4 is a distinct branch.

The separately published Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB GGUF has a 20.51 GiB weight file. Its fully resident text path exceeds either GPU and no equivalent local/Opus role test was established. It remains a discovery observation.

fit_assumption: 16 GiB is the nominal total per card. Offload minima use artifact size plus estimated one-sequence FP16 attention KV when available. CUDA workspaces, image projectors, recurrent state, reservations, exact tensor placement and live memory pressure require measurement. GGUF downloads stage in place on one filesystem and use rename on commit. Unit GiB = 2^30 bytes.
eligibility_note: Explicit shortlist candidates may be assessed before demonstrating parity. No extra model is approved for deployment and none is certified Opus-equivalent by these figures.

runtime_probe_scope.method: Read GGUF architecture metadata and checked name in the actual compiled library. A registered name alone does not prove tensor/kernel compatibility or target speed. No model load.
runtime_probe_scope.priority: Single candidate, single GPU, single slot first; all allocation or deployment changes remain owner-controlled.
